docs: document contributor coordination workflow

- require each active contributor to maintain one coordination comment
- prefer scope-based claims, with individual functions as a fallback
- require agents to check coordination state before starting or assigning work
- keep claims active until work reaches master
- avoid committing reservation/queue state to the repository

Workflow agreed with llesieur99.
